Peak bulletin for anyone travelling with a pet
Someone on the desk wanted you to know

Travelers, please read this before you fly with an animal.

Aurelia Skyways wants your trip to stay calm and safe, and that means a few pet checks matter more than speed. The Companion Animal Travel Desk is sorry if the rules feel fussy, but they help handlers keep things humane and steady for every animal in the cabin or crate.

Please make sure the crate, papers, and handoff details are ready before you arrive. <<FACT F070>> This is especially important for rabbits, since a poor fit can turn a simple trip into a rough one. <<FACT F057>> We also ask you to keep your pet settled and follow the desk guidance closely, so boarding can move along without stress.

If anything looks uncertain, please speak with the Companion Animal Travel Desk before you travel.
